title: Sporty Types
blurb: Footy tragics, gym legends, sideline coaches and the keen one who always has a tracksuit on.

questions.text: Who would be most likely to shout at a TV like the players can hear them?
Who is most likely to pull a hamstring in a charity fun run?
Who would be most likely to win the egg and spoon race at a school reunion?
Who would cry when their team loses a grand final?
Who among us is most likely to wear a team scarf in thirty-degree heat?
Who would be most likely to sign up for a marathon and quit at the first water station?
Who do you reckon is most likely to buy the full kit of a sport they've never played?
Who's the one most likely to be the sideline parent who has to be calmed down?
Who would be most likely to take a swing at a golf ball and hit the one behind them?
Who is most likely to win a tennis match by sheer stubbornness?
Who would be most likely to own a gym membership and use it twice?
Who would claim an old injury every time they lose?
Who among us is most likely to start a backyard cricket match and refuse to be out?
Who would be most likely to lead a team huddle in the middle of a pub quiz?
Who do you reckon is most likely to run the family footy tipping comp and take it all too seriously?
Who's the one most likely to have a lucky pair of socks for every big match?
Who would be most likely to run a half marathon without telling anyone and then mention it constantly?
Who is most likely to retire from a social sports team and come back the next week?
Who would be most likely to get a surfboard and never get in the water?
Who would bring orange slices to a kid's game and be the hero?
Who among us is most likely to take a rest day and then a rest week?
Who would be most likely to join a gym class and spend the whole time hiding at the back?
Who do you reckon is most likely to bring an esky and camp chairs to a kids' soccer game?
Who's the one most likely to dive for a ball and miss it by a metre?
Who would be most likely to try yoga and fall asleep in the final pose?
Who is most likely to scream at a ref over a game they aren't even watching?
Who would be most likely to complain about the weather and then play anyway?
Who would organise a footy trip to another city for one match?
Who among us is most likely to give a locker-room speech to a team of six-year-olds?
Who would be most likely to challenge a stranger to a push-up contest?
Who do you reckon is most likely to shout "I was robbed!" after losing at mini golf?
Who's the one most likely to wear full lycra for a short walk?
Who would be most likely to try a new extreme sport and need an ambulance by lunch?
Who is most likely to get a medal and wear it to dinner?
Who would be most likely to say "I'm just here for the pies" at a match?
Who would switch teams when theirs starts losing?
Who among us is most likely to enter a hot dog eating contest to win a prize?
Who would be most likely to take a golf lesson and quit after the first swing?
Who do you reckon is most likely to bring a whistle to a family game?
Who's the one most likely to be the first picked for the team and the last to be useful?
Who would be most likely to play through an injury and insist it is fine?
Who is most likely to swap with the goalie and let in five goals?
Who would be most likely to cheer for the wrong team by mistake?
Who would win gold in competitive arguing?
